dct_title_s: Terra Sancta quae in Sacris Terra Promissionis ol. Palestina
dct_description_sm: 2 bar scale on map, given in “Horæ itineris” and “Milliaria Germanica.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
"Von Canaan” at top of sheet; “319” in upper right.
Appears in Jansson's Atlas minor, German edition, Amsterdam, 1651.
This copy has pencil inscriptions in lower left: 190; Holy Land; and lower right: Jansson 1651.
"320" on verso, and German text: Von Canaan.
